Wait, what are the color codes? The problem says walls on nest side are RED, source half walls are BLUE and GREEN. The floor: WHITE=nest, BLACK=source, GRAY=middle. Color IDs: looking at the mission description, the available colors for `--clr` are {1,2,3,4,5,6}. Typically in ARGoS: 1=red, 2=green, 3=blue, 4=yellow, 5=magenta, 6=cyan (or similar).

If green walls are on one side of the source, moving away from green would push robots toward the other half (blue walls side), which decreases score. So the robot is effectively foraging from the correct (blue) side.

The second-best uses GoToColor clr=2 (moving toward green) with a fallback - scores only -2.66.

- The key insight: robots need to go to the BLACK floor (source), pick up items, then return to WHITE floor (nest). GoAwayColor from RED walls (color 1) would push toward the source.
